notes: τὸν ἅγιον καὶ δίκαιον is read under rule 102: the article takes *the … One* headed on the supplied nominal, and each adjective keeps its own bare word.
ἄνδρα φονέα → *a murderer* is split with ἄνδρα `unrepresented`, *murderer* alone answering to φονέα; joining the two nouns on that one English phrase remains defensible and the unit note says so.
